working_model: Independent identically distributed Bernoulli defect indicators with one constant unknown probability p. Null hypothesis is the COMPLETE interval0<=p<=0.2. At a look with n cumulative observations and k cumulative defects, use the exact one-sided upper-tail p-value P[Binomial(n,0.2)>=k].
nominal_protocol: At each declared look, reject if its exact p-value is <=the declared family error limit. Stop at the FIRST rejection; otherwise continue to the final declared look. Report the first-crossing probabilities specifically at the null BOUNDARY p=0.2. These are UNCONDITIONAL probabilities at that parameter value, not probabilities conditional on reaching a look and not separate maxima over p for each look.
adjusted_protocol: Use the same looks and stopping rule but compare every p-value with the declared family error limit DIVIDED BY the total number of declared looks. The look schedule is fixed before data. Do not divide by the number actually reached.
reporting: For each protocol report the actual worst-case null probability of at least one rejection, not a union-bound substitute, Monte Carlo estimate or sum of overlapping marginal rejection probabilities. A count threshold n+1means no attainable count rejects. Threshold and first-crossing arrays follow cumulative_look_sizes.

provenance.data_origin: Explicit controlled benchmark model and exact numerical inputs; not an empirical laboratory, ecological or classifier-performance claim.
